ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic screening standards: Under Ley 23 de 2015, Article 35, registered agents, notaries, and designated non-financial professions must conduct enhanced due diligence on politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates. Screenings must be performed against the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the European Union sanctions lists, and Panama's national financial intelligence list maintained by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF). Cross-referencing with commercial databases such as World-Check or Refinitiv is mandatory. Ongoing monitoring must occur at a minimum of every six months or upon any transaction trigger, and all findings must be reported to the UAF per the SAR/STR protocol.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — eRegistro (name search and reservation via the online portal of the Public Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Foundation names must incorporate the word 'Fundación' or the abbreviation 'F.'; names may be expressed in Spanish or English, but all non-Latin script names must be transliterated into Latin characters. The name must be distinctive and not misleadingly identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity in the Public Registry. The inclusion of a numeric or specially formed identifier is optional. Names that improperly imply a corporate form such as 'S.A.' are subject to rejection unless accompanied by proper corporate authorization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or its registered agent may file a 'recurso de reconsideración' with the Director General of the Public Registry within 30 business days from notification, followed by a 'recurso de apelación' before the Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI) within 10 business days. If both administrative appeals are exhausted, the applicant may seek judicial annulment through the Tercera Sala de la Corte Suprema de Justicia. Name reservation extensions are not permitted by statute; a fresh application after the expiration of the 30-day validity window is required unless the original application remains pending in administrative appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permitted for the registered office of a Private Interest Foundation. The foundation must maintain a registered agent (abogado inscrito) with a physical office within the Republic of Panama, and the registered office address must correspond to the actual physical office of the registered agent. However, the foundation's underlying business operations, including bonded warehouse activities, may be carried out in separate premises in a Free Trade Zone with the required operational license. Virtual or shared directors' meeting spaces are permissible for non-resident directors, but the statutory registered office cannot be virtual.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For a Private Interest Foundation acting as a holding entity, unannounced physical inspections are rare (estimated 5% annual probability). If the foundation directly operates or licenses a bonded warehouse depot in a Free Trade Zone, the combined compliance risk elevates the unannounced inspection likelihood to 30% per year due to the enhanced scrutiny of the Dirección General de Ingresos, the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas, and the Superintendencia de Bancos where financial transactions are involved.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 25 de 1995 (as amended by Ley No. 41 de 1995 and Ley No. 13 de 2013) creating Private Interest Foundations; Title I, Articles 1-8 (constitution, endowment, council); Public Registry Regulations under Código de Familia and Registro Público rules
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Departamento de Fundaciones de Interés Privado, Panama City
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Fundación de Interés Privado (Notarially Executed Foundation Charter)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Statutory minimum initial endowment of USD 10,000 (or equivalent) per Article 8; must be declared in the Charter but payment proof is not filed; for bonded depot licensing, Customs Bond or bank guarantee posts as security instead of paid-up capital
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Private Interest Foundation PA_PIF is duly constituted and its initial endowment of USD 10,000 is declared fully subscribed and received from the Founder. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Foundation's registered office and Resident Agent be established in Panama City, Republic of Panama, with the law firm of [◆] appointed as Resident Agent. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Foundation Council is appointed with [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Council is authorized to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and obtain all Free Trade Zone bonded depot licenses, environmental permits, and fire safety clearances. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all pre-incorporation actions taken by the Founder are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Departamento de Registro de Fundaciones (online clearing house)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for a name availability certificate for 'PA_PIF Foundation' by e-form or in person; ensure no identical or deceptively similar entity name is registered; pay the certificate search fee and obtain the Certificado de Búsqueda; the certificate remains valid for 90 days
required_dossiers: Name search application form
Identity copy of proposed Foundation Council member
Power of attorney (if using a Panamanian attorney-in-fact)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is refused or reserved by another entity, submit a written rebuttal or choose a secondary name variant; re-file the search with a new denomination at no additional Registry fee except the re-search tariff

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Execution of the Foundation Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama (selected notary with Registry accreditation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Escritura Pública containing foundation name, registered office, endowment, Council members, object (bonded warehouse operations in a Free Trade Zone), and succession rules; the Founder or authorized attorney must appear before the notary to sign; notary authenticates the instrument, numbers it, and returns it to the Registry for protocolization; pay notarial fees and stamp taxes
required_dossiers: Valid ID or passport of Founder
Certificado de Búsqueda (name certificate)
Draft charter with Foundation object (ISIC 5210 bonded depot)
Residence or corporate address of Council members
Power of attorney if executed by representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notary detects inconsistencies or legal clauses contrary to Ley 25 de 1995, the charter is redrafted and re-executed; the Founder may appoint a substitute notary without prejudice within 5 business days

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Oficina de Entrada de Documentos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the protocolized notarial copy to the Registry's filing office; pay the inscription fee (approx. USD 150) and fiscal stamp duties; the Registry assigns a Ficha (entity number) and issues the registered certificate for the Private Interest Foundation within the statutory review period
required_dossiers: Protocolized Escritura Pública (original and two copies)
Fiscal stamp payments (Papel Sellado and stamps)
Registry application form signed by authorized attorney
Certificate of payment of Registration tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registry may issue an 'advertencia' or defect notice; file corrective instrument within the registry-granted 10-day curing period; if exceeded, re-file with new fee and revised instrument

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification Registration with the National Revenue Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — Oficina de Registro de Contribuyentes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form 108 (Registro Único de Contribuyente) electronically through SIE portal; attach registered Foundation charter proof and Council resolution appointing the legal representative; obtain the RUC number required for all future customs, payroll, and supplier registrations
required_dossiers: Registered Foundation charter (certified copy)
Council resolution naming fiscal representative
RUC application Form 108
Power of attorney for tax filings
Panama lease agreement for registered office if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI rejects for missing documents, resubmit within 10 days; discrepancies in address require a corrected lease or Resident Agent letter; appeal via the DGI's Consulta Administrativa channel

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá (or Municipalidad of Colón / La Chorrera depending on Free Trade Zone location) — Ventanilla Única de Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Aviso de Operación for bonded logistics under ISIC 5210-493110; pay the municipal rate based on assigned schedules; obtain the assigned business licenses and the municipal file number (ficha municipal) proving lawful commercial presence
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Certified copy of Foundation registered charter
Lease deed or right-to-use title for depot premises
Fire prevention certificate preliminary inspection (for building)
Proof of payment of municipal charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal rejections for zoning or property documentation are cured by obtaining the relevant land-use certificate (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) from the Municipality Planning Office and re-presenting the file

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Customs Bonded Depot Authorization and Free Trade Zone Operating License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) — Departamento de Regímenes Especiales, jointly with the Free Trade Zone Administrator (Zona Libre de Colón or Panama Pacífico Agency)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the customs authorization application for a Fiscal/Bonded Warehouse in a Free Trade Zone; submit a technical, security, and inventory control plan (E-record book system); procure and file a customs bond or bank guarantee of sufficient amount fixed by ANA Valuation Committee; obtain the Free Trade Zone operator's license/concession contract; undergo ANA's physical inspection of the warehouse premises and security systems before final approval
required_dossiers: Duly signed customs authorization form (Form 333)
Technical security plan of the bonded depot
Inventory control system description (EDI/electronic connectivity)
Customs bond agreement or guarantee letter
Fire safety certificate from Panamanian Fire Service
Memorandum of constitutional fact for the Free Trade Zone concession
RUC for tariffs
Environmental suitability certificate if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ANA denies or defers, file a 'Recurso de Reconsideración' within 5 business days; correct all physical deficiencies specified in the inspection report; address environmental observations from MiAMBIENTE through a new classification evaluation; if the Free Trade Zone administration refuses the concession, request an arbitration clause activation under the applicable zone regulations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas, Dirección de Regímenes Especiales, and the governing Free Trade Zone Administrator (Zona Libre de Colón / Panama Pacífico / CUFAD)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Operación de Almacén de Depósito Fiscal / Zona Franca (Bonded Depot Operating License in a Free Trade Zone) issued by ANA, plus the Concesión Operativa de Zona Franca granted by the relevant Free Trade Zone Administration

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (General Registration with Informe Ambiental Preliminar) for low-impact bonded warehouses up to 10,000 m²; Category II (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental – EsIA) for projects exceeding 10,000 m², chemical-handling depots, or those adjacent to protected watersheds; hydrocarbon or hazardous-goods storage requires full EsIA Category III
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Reglamento de Descargas Líquidas (Executive Decreto No. 131 de 1998) — pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 250 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L before any discharge to public waters; air emissions subject to Protocolo Técnico CA 134/1998 for volatile organic compounds (VOC) — total hydrocarbons threshold ≤ 20 mg/m³ for ventilation stacks; all waste oil and oily residues must be collected by an authorized hazardous waste transporter under Resolución DGNTI-COPANIT 001-2000; stormwater containment and spill-containment berms required inside the bonded premises to prevent soil contamination
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Certificado de Seguridad y Protección Civil) issued by the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá, including inspection of sprinkler systems, hydrant flow rates, and fire extinguisher compliance; structural load certificate from the Municipal Engineering / Dirección de Obras y Construcciones verifying floor live load capacity for racking systems; occupational workplace certificate (Certificado de Salud y Seguridad Laboral) to be obtained through MITRADEL's Dirección de Higiene y Seguridad Ocupacional for storage premises, covering forklift safety, manual handling protocols, and noise exposure limits

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Panama; principal digital portal is the DGI e-Tax platform at https://dgi.mef.gob.pa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Private Interest Foundation (PIF) must obtain a Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) for Panama-source taxable activities. The procedure requires: (1) notarized and apostilled foundation charter (Pacto Fundacional) and registration in the Registry of Private Interest Foundations; (2) appointment of a resident agent in Panama; (3) filing the application via the DGI with the foundation's corporate documents, directors' identification, and proof of fiscal address; (4) obtaining a provisional RUC and registering as an exporter if export zero-rating will be claimed; and (5) activating the electronic invoicing system with DGI-authorized invoice numbering.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not maintain a general check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election. A PIF engaged in bonded warehouse operations within a free trade zone may elect to be taxed as a free trade zone operator under Law 32 of 2011 and related FTZ regulations, which achieves territorial treatment and ITBMS exemption for export-related supplies. PIFs may also elect the small taxpayer simplified regime if annual gross revenue is below the threshold. No consolidated return election is available; hybrid mismatch rules under Panama's BEPS-influenced framework have limited application because foreign-source income is outside the territorial tax net.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios, ITBMS)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD 36,000 annual gross taxable turnover for simplified taxpayer status; mandatory full RUC registration applies regardless of threshold when the entity carries on taxable business activities or exports goods or services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates DGI-authorized electronic invoicing for all registered taxpayers. The DGI operates a real-time fiscal control system whereby invoices must be legally authorized, sequentially numbered, and transmitted through the e-Tax/facturación electrónica platform. Free trade zone bond warehouses must use the DGI's electronic clearance APIs for dispatch notes, customs-linked exit declarations, and zero-rated export invoices. Digital stamping of receipts and fiscal codes is required before invoices become valid for audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for ITBMS purposes on the export of tangible goods from Panamanian customs territory and for services physically or effectively rendered abroad to non-resident customers. A free trade zone bonded depot qualifies as an exporter for this purpose, provided the goods are introduced into an FTZ, stored in a bonded warehouse, and subsequently transferred to a foreign buyer or shipped to an export destination. Supporting evidence must demonstrate that title, possession, and risk of loss passed outside Panama.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA or electronic customs export form)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing exit from Panama
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank wire transfer statement evidencing payment from the foreign buyer
Bonded warehouse entry and exit inventory records
Free trade zone operator certificate and movement permit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI audit review will scrutinize the link between goods evidenced in the customs declaration and the bond warehouse inventory records, the existence of genuine foreign counterparties, and the actual repatriation of sale proceeds. Failure to repatriate export collections within 180 days, fabrication of export documentation, or unjustified zero-rating triggers retrospective clawback of ITBMS at 7%, late payment surcharge, inflation-adjusted interest, and fines of up to 200 percent of the tax evaded. Criminal tax evasion and customs fraud penalties can include imprisonment and suspension of the bonded warehouse license, and the PIF loses the free trade zone operating permit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), established by Decreto Ley No. 2 of 22 February 2008, as the sole prudential regulator and foreign-exchange data supervisor; Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) acts as the fiscal agent and settlement bank for the national clearing system. Panama has no central bank with monetary issuance power: the US Dollar circulates as unlimited legal tender under Cabinet Decree No. 238 of 1904 and Article 206 of the Panamanian Constitution (full dollarization). The Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) coordinates external financing and sovereign treasury policy, while the SBP compiles balance-of-payments statistics in accordance with IMF BPM6.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama maintains a fully dollarized monetary regime with unrestricted currency convertibility for both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange controls, no central bank authorization for FX operations, and no restrictions on profit remittances or capital repatriation by a Private Interest Foundation (PIF). Under the territorial tax system of Panama (Ley 254 de 2021 and prior Fiscal Code rules), income derived from bonded warehouse operations serving third-country goods is not Panamanian source income; distributions to foreign founders and beneficiaries are free of Panamanian withholding tax. Practical hurdles are limited to AML/financial-intelligence gates imposed by SBP-regulated banks: wire transfers above USD 10,000 are subject to automated monitoring and the FATF Travel Rule; remittances of large PIF capital injections (≥ USD 500,000) typically require a source-of-funds affidavit and, for certain jurisdictions, a foreign tax-residency certificate. Despite these documentation gates, the jurisdiction is rated A1 (full convertibility) with no forced conversion, no surrender requirements, and no multiple-currency-practice restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds in Panama. Bonded depot operators within Free Trade Zones (Law 41 of 2007; Executive Decree No. 6 of 2015; ANA resolutions) may invoice in USD or any freely convertible currency, retain export earnings in domestic or foreign bank accounts, and disburse them without time limitation or conversion ratio. The sole compliance obligations are: (i) reporting of cash transactions exceeding USD 10,000 through the SBP's financial intelligence system (Law 23 of 2015; Decreto 131 de 2020); (ii) including complete originator/beneficiary information in every international wire (FATF Recommendation 16 / Travel Rule); and (iii) filing customs and trade statistics declarations through the Aduana Nacional (SIGA/Impune) for each shipment. Export proceeds may be held indefinitely offshore, provided that the PIF maintains an Economic Substance Return (Ley 254 de 2021) evidencing real management and commercial activity in Panama.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Settlement Account (USD) + Capital Escrow Sub-account
Capital Escrow Account / Statutory Reserve Account; also the national clearing settlement account
Operational Trade Account with trade-finance desk (LC issuance, documentary collections)
Capital Escrow Account / International Wealth Management Account for foreign-owned PIFs
Operational Account (secondary settlement rail for local clearing)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: HIGH as a supplementary liquidity accelerator; LOW-MEDIUM as a primary treasury bank. Panama's fintech regulatory sandbox ('Centro de Innovación Fintech', SBP Agreement No. 004-2020) permits licensed processors to test digital payment products, but non-bank electronic money institutions domiciled abroad (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) hold no Panamanian banking license and cannot operate nostro accounts in Panama. The Banking Law (Decreto Ley No. 2 of 2008, Articles 2 and 83) requires that deposit-taking and payment intermediation for a Panamanian FTZ operator be performed through an SBP-supervised bank. Consequently, the optimal treasury architecture is an SBP-licensed Tier-1 bank as the principal USD clearing and custody rail, with a regulated fintech EMI (FCA/ASIC/EMI-licensed) used only for incidental non-USD vendor payouts, customer collections in EUR/GBP/CNY, and sub-threshold trade tickets. All fintech-originated balances must be swept daily into the Panamanian master account to comply with the 'banking exclusivity' principle and to avoid an unlicensed deposit-taking characterization.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De facto rule: for a foreigner-owned PIF holding a bonded-depot licence in a Free Trade Zone, at least one director or the ultimate beneficial owner with signature authority must attend an initial physical KYC interview at the selected bank's corporate or private-banking office in Panama City. SBP Resolution No. 0006-2018 permits video-identification, but it does not waive the initial in-person enhanced due diligence (EDD) session for a medium-risk FTZ commercial entity. Remote opening remains available at selected institutions (notably Towerbank International and Banistmo's wealth management desk) when the PIF's registered agent is an existing bank client, and when the following are delivered: (i) apostilled Foundation Deed (Escritura Pública) and Internal Regulations; (ii) certified Beneficial Ownership Schedule under Law 23 of 2015 / Decreto 131 de 2020; (iii) board resolution authorizing account opening and mandated signatories; and (iv) a notarized 'Conozca su Cliente' certificate issued by Panamanian counsel. Standard onboarding time for a remote-approved PIF is 10-15 business days; physical-interview onboarding is 5-10 business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foundation-law opacity — the PIF is a hybrid entity; the founder/councillor relationship and irrevocable beneficiary class may obscure ultimate beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Public Deed of Foundation and Internal Regulations; registered agent's Certificate of Good Standing; current Beneficial Owner Schedule filed with the Registro Público DNFBP under Law 23 of 2015; legal opinion from Panamanian counsel identifying the UBO and the source of the capital endowment; sworn declaration of the PIF Council confirming that no bearer instruments or unidentified beneficiary classes exist.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering — a bonded depot in a free-trade zone handles third-country goods with complex title chains; invoicing gaps or over/under-invoicing trigger SBP Red Flag indicators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Warehouse operating licence (Aviso de Operación under Law 41 of 2007); custodian and sub-custodian contracts; non-negotiable warehouse receipts; purchase and sale agreements for each inventory batch; SWIFT/LC payment evidence; transport documentation (bill of lading, CMR, air waybill); packing lists; customs declarations (SIGA/Impune) with entry/exit codes; annual independent inventory audit certificate issued by a PCAOB-comparable Panamanian CPA firm.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geopolitical and sanctions exposure — high-seas trading partners, transshipment through multiple flags, or emerging-market counterparties intersecting with OFAC, EU, or UN consolidated sanctions lists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time OFAC SDN list screening report; EU consolidated financial sanctions search; UNSC consolidated list check; passport or corporate registry extracts for all counterparties; end-user certificates and country-of-origin certificates for restricted or dual-use items; vessel-specific documentation including IMO number, flag state, and current AIS track; shipping-lane compliance certificate from the P&I club or a recognized maritime compliance bureau.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large capital injections (≥ USD 1,000,000) or irregular high-volume third-party pass-through payments inconsistent with the declared bonded depot business model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Council board minutes authorizing the injection; foundation capital plan and projected throughput volume; six months of bank statements at the originator bank; notarized source-of-funds affidavit from the parent entity or founder; certified public accountant attestation on fund provenance; the PIF's Economic Substance Return (Ley 254 de 2021) demonstrating real activity in the operation and management of the bonded depot in Panama; customer agreements and warehouse utilisation forecasts to explain pass-through patterns.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) Pre-move notification by the PIF Council to the designated account officer detailing the injection amount, the underlying FTZ lease and warehouse contracts, and the UBO. (2) Remittance via SWIFT MT103 from the founding entity, with the ordering customer field matching the documented founder name and the beneficiary account field (party 57) reflecting the PIF's registered exact name and account number at the Panamanian bank; use a prime correspondent such as JPMorgan Chase New York, Bank of New York Mellon, or HSBC US. (3) Purpose/remittance codes under Panama's SBP BPM6 statistical classification: for equity injection use 'Direct investment — equity capital' (code 1110); for shareholder loans use 'Direct investment — intercompany lending' (code 1120); for ordinary trade-related funding use 'Trade credit — non-financial enterprise' (code 2A2B). (4) Verification bundle for the AML desk: apostilled Foundation Deed, registered agent undertaking, PIF tax ID (RUC), active Free Trade Zone operator licence issued by the Administración General de Aduanas (ANA), and the sworn Economic Substance Declaration evidencing real activity. (5) For injections ≥ USD 500,000, banks commonly require an 'Investment Origination' certificate from the remitting bank or a tax-residency certificate of the investor; the same documents must be retained for the SBP's EDD file in the event of an inspection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for open-account settlement of imported bonded inventory and supplier payables; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit governed by UCP 600 (ICC Publication 600) issued through the Panamanian bank's trade desk for high-value or first-time supplier transactions; (iii) documentary collections (D/P and D/A) for incumbent suppliers in emerging markets; and (iv) local USD clearing via the Cámara de Compensación Bancaria de Panamá, operated by Banco Nacional de Panamá with the SENI electronic payments system, for payments to other FTZ operators inside the Colon Free Zone, Panama Pacifico, or domestic logistics providers. Each outgoing MT103 must carry the exact beneficiary legal entity name and SWIFT BIC/IBAN; the remittance information field must reference the underlying commercial invoice, LC number, or customs entry (Declaración de Mercancía) to satisfy SBP AML traceability. There is no Panamanian domestic RTGS for USD beyond BNP's clearing window; same-day settlement is achieved only through SENI business-hours processing. For intra-FTZ transfers, the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas requires a 'declaración de mercancía en tránsito' to be attached when goods move between bonded depots.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (USD/CNY, USD/EUR, USD/JPY) executed through international bank branches outside Panama, given the absence of an onshore deliverable FX market and full dollarization

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on emerging-market currencies (e.g., CNY, KRW, INR) for third-country bonded-supplier hedging, transacted under ISDA documentation with SBP-permitted non-speculative trade exposure

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD vs EUR/CNY) under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with New York law governing default and netting, provided the PIF has documented treasury risk policies and board authorisation

Layered tenor forwards with cash-collateral margin accounts (not physically settled) for staggered inventory procurement cycles, strictly limited to underlying commercial exposure and never for speculative treasury trading

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax / Annual Legal Entity Tax (Pago Anual de Impuesto de Persona Jurídica)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Directorate of Revenue (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March each year, or 90 days after the end of the chosen fiscal period; newly formed entities must make the pro-rated initial payment within 90 days of registration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest and a 10% surcharge; the Public Registry blocks all notarial and corporate acts until regularized; administrative suspension and strike-off risk after two consecutive unpaid annual periods.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Resident Agent AML File Update (Ley 23 de 2015)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Public Registry of Panama and the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF), through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due no later than 30 April each year; interim updates required within 15 calendar days of any change in founder rights, foundation council, protector, or beneficiary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Loss of good standing before the Public Registry; administrative fines imposed by the UAF for AML/CFT record failures; refusal by registered agents to continue representation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Free Trade Zone Bonded Depot Operational License Renewal and Customs Acknowledgment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Directorate of Free Trade Zones, Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI); National Customs Authority (ANA) for bonded status acknowledgment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application submitted no later than 60 days before the annual expiration of the free trade zone operating permit and bonded warehouse authorization.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired license invalidates bonded warehouse status; all customs transactions are intercepted; continued unlicensed operation triggers administrative fines, depot closure, and potential revocation of the free zone contract.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Books and Accounting Records Certification for the Preceding Financial Period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Retained by the Private Interest Foundation; inspection-ready for the Public Registry, DGI, UAF, and ANA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Certification completed by the due date of the annual franchise tax filing, generally 31 March, covering records for the preceding financial year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to retain seven years of books and underlying records constitutes a tax and AML/CFT violation; sanctions include DGI/UAF monetary fines, evidentiary adverse inference, and suspension of the entity's tax good standing certificate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies to Private Interest Foundations operating as free trade zone bonded depots when the entity is classified as a Large Taxpayer by the DGI, when annual turnover exceeds the DGI's audit threshold for commercial entities, or when the MICI free zone contract, ANA bonded warehouse authorization, or surety agreement expressly requires audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the Colegio de Contadores Públicos de Panamá and accepted by the tax and customs authorities; supplementary customs records follow ANA/MICI formats but no separate local GAAP is applied.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident agent must maintain current information on the founder, foundation council, protectors, and beneficiaries. Any transfer of founder rights, assignment of economic interest, or substitution of beneficiaries must be recorded in the private foundation file and reported to the Public Registry within 15 days. An annual re-confirmation of all beneficial owners is due by 30 April each year, including a sworn declaration for any transfer occurring during the prior year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficiaries and Founder Rights
Minute Book (Actas del Consejo de la Fundación)
Complete Foundation File with Original Deed, Amendments, and Registered Agent Endorsements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 to USD 750 per year for licensed registered agent and registered office services, inclusive of AML/CFT oversight and UBO record updates
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 to USD 8,500 per year for a certified audit of a bonded warehouse and free trade zone trade operation in Panama

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation restricts the 25% headline rate to net income derived from Panamanian source. A licensed Colon Free Zone (CFZ) bonded-depot operator may elect the special fee-in-lieu-of-tax regime (1% on cumulative installed capital or 2% on gross income depending on concession vintage) in place of the 25% corporate income tax. Qualifying Panama-Pacifico Area logistics operators enjoy a 20-year income-tax exemption for bonded logistics activities. Profits from the re-export of goods that never enter Panamanian customs territory remain effectively taxed at 0%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 300 (Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas) filed through the DGI E-Tax online portal; quarterly estimated prepayments are remitted via Formulario 301.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December fiscal year-end, the statutory deadline is 31 March of the following year, unless the DGI administratively extends the calendar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identity: RUC number, legal name, fiscal period, primary ISIC activity (5210 – bonded warehouse operations in customs free trade zones), and bonded-depot licence reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned Private Interest Foundation (PIF) must first obtain a Panama RUC and, once the bonded-depot licence is effective, must file Form 300 regardless of the residence of its founder or beneficiaries.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from Panamanian-source operations: storage, handling, fumigation, re-packing and ancillary customs-bonded services physically rendered inside the free trade zone.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude freight, insurance and commission revenue earned abroad. Retain supporting waybills, vessel schedules and invoices to substantiate the territorial-source exclusion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Re-export sales margin and services relating to goods admitted to the free zone and subsequently exported without entering Panamanian customs territory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the CFZ entry and exit declarations and the warehouse ERP inventory report. Do not net the CFZ annual fee or other operating fees against this exempt-income block.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs and deductible expenses in the net-basis regime: bond guarantee premiums, warehouse rent, licensed staff payroll, security and utilities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the taxpayer is on the CFZ gross-fee alternative regime, the deductions block remains blank. Any intercompany rent or management fee payable to the PIF must be supported by a transfer pricing study.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable: 25% of the net taxable base, or the CFZ/Panama-Pacifico alternative fee where the special regime is applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit the quarterly Form 301 prepayments and any withholding credits. Undistributed income of the PIF is not taxed in the hands of non-resident beneficiaries at this stage.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed tax less prepayments, withholding credits and any payments made under the alternative regime; the outcome is either a balance payable with the return or a credit to be offset.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A zero balance is accepted only when the PIF demonstrates absence of Panamanian-source activity; attach the sworn territorial-source statement and the annual economic substance declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge on the tax due for the first month of delay plus 2.5% per additional month, capped at 50%, together with a fixed minimum fine of B/.50–B/.500 (Article 710, Código Fiscal), annual default interest at 10%, and suspension of DGI good-taxpayer status; non-filing tolls the applicable limitation period.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed by a Panamanian legal entity from Panamanian-source taxable profits (Article 733, Código Fiscal). Dividends paid from profits generated under the CFZ fee-in-lieu-of-tax regime are treated as distributions of exempt income and carry a 0% Panama withholding for non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The procedure is: (i) confirm the applicable in-force Panama DTA (the network includes the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Singapore, UAE, Qatar, Switzerland, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, Argentina, France and Barbados); (ii) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) and a beneficial-ownership statement from the foreign tax authority; (iii) deliver both to the Panamanian withholding agent before settlement of the dividend; (iv) record the reduced rate in the DGI E-Tax withholding module and retain the documents for at least five years; and (v) satisfy any Limitation-on-Benefits clause by evidencing active logistics business in the free zone, not merely a passive PIF holding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 12.5% statutory withholding on Panamanian-source payments for the use of patents, trademarks, software and know-how (Article 733, Código Fiscal), commonly reduced to the 5%–10% band under DTA schedules. Interest: interest on cross-border bank loans and external trade finance is exempt from Panamanian withholding under the territorial-source rule; other Panamanian-source interest paid to non-residents is subject to a 12.5% statutory WHT, reducible to 5%–10% under the relevant DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/. 1,500,000 (Panamanian balboas, at par with the US dollar) of annual Panamanian-source gross income triggers the mandatory Form 305 transfer pricing informative return and the Local File and Master File obligations under DGI Resolution 201-2810 of 2019; Country-by-Country Reporting applies to Panamanian groups with consolidated revenue exceeding US$750 million.
